description: This file defines the class SugarURIFilter, a custom URI filter for HTMLPurifier within the SuiteCRM project. It implements URL sanitization to allow only trusted domains and specific URL patterns to prevent CSRF attacks.

classes.name: SugarURIFilter
classes.description: A URI filter class that extends HTMLPurifier's URI filter to only allow URLs from trusted domains and certain patterns, mainly to mitigate CSRF risks.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Loads the trusted domains from the SugarCRM configuration and initializes the allowed list for URL filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines whether a given URI should be permitted based on schemes, hosts, paths, and query parameters, primarily to prevent malicious URL exploits.
